questions.q: Q42. Is there much ____ you need to buy? [SSC MTS 2023]
questions.s: "Much" takes "that". 'Much' के बाद 'that' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.q:
All the young boys and girls / in the family / will try his luck / in the card games tonight.

(SSC CHSL 09/06/2022 S1)
o: All the young boys and girls
questions.s:
The error is in "will try his luck".

The subject "All the young boys and girls" is plural, so the pronoun should be "their" instead of "his".

Correct sentence: All the young boys and girls in the family will try their luck in the card games tonight.

questions.q: The teachers, who I worked with, were very insensitive towards children's needs.
o: The teachers, who I worked with
questions.s:
After a preposition like with, we must use the objective case of the relative pronoun: “whom”, not who.
So it should be: “The teachers, whom I worked with, were very insensitive…”

questions.q:
Meera has a friend who parents live in Dubai.

[CGL PRE 13/06/2019 S1]
o: has a friend which parents live
have a friend whom parents live
has a friend whose parents live
questions.s:
Correct Answer: has a friend whose parents live

In this sentence, "whose" is correct because it shows possession. It connects the friend to their parents.

Correct Sentence: Meera has a friend whose parents live in Dubai.

"whose" means "of whom" and is used for possession.

questions.q: It goes without saying  / that your house which / is in Delhi is far better / than my one in various ways.
o: It goes without saying
that your house which
is in Delhi is far better
than my one in various ways
questions.s: Explanation:- Your house ka comparison 'my house' se hona hai jiske liye Possessive pronoun "mine" ka use hoga 'My one' jaisa English me koi shabd nahi hai.

questions.q:
A misunderstanding has crept between he and his sister.

[SSC CGL MAINS 08/08/2022]
questions.s:
Correct Answer: between he

"between he" is incorrect because after the preposition "between," the objective case of the pronoun must be used. The objective form of "he" is "him."

Correct Sentence: A misunderstanding has crept between him and his sister.

questions.q: Q12. She is the only girl ____ can dance well. [CDS II 2022]
questions.s: "The only" takes "that". 'The only' के साथ 'that' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.q: Q17. A current account is a deposit account (a)/ which is offered by banks mainly (b)/ to firms and companies who (c)/ need banking facilities very frequently.(d)
o: D) need banking facilities very frequently.(d)
C) to firms and companies who (c)
B) which is offered by banks mainly (b)
A) A current account is a deposit account (a)
questions.s: 'Who' is used for human beings. For non-living entities like 'firms and companies', use 'which' or 'that'.

questions.q: This is the sportsperson (1)/ whom I think has won (2)/ the much coveted prize. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.s:
After “I think”, the clause requires the subject form, because the verb “has won” needs a subject.
So “whom” (object) is wrong; it should be “who” (subject).

questions.q:
Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

This is the album who I found in the garage.
questions.s: Replace 'who' with 'that'. The pronoun 'who', is an interrogative pronoun and a relative pronoun, used primarily to refer to persons. Ex: The musician who wrote this song is Canadian. 'That' can be used for people, animals or things. Ex- Lisa wore the shoes that she bought in Italy.

questions.q: In practice rounds, my caddie, Greg, / and me works on my short / game with a baseball glove. (SSC MTS Tier-01 19/06/23)
o: And me works on my short
In practice rounds, my caddie, Greg
questions.s: 'Me' is an object pronoun; the subject pronoun 'I' is needed. Also, the verb should be 'work'.

questions.q: Q45. Q45. It is yourself who will decide your future.
questions.s: The structure "It is..." introduces the subject. The subjective pronoun "you" is required, not the reflexive "yourself".

questions.q: After a long gap, / we went shopping / last Sunday and bought / that we wanted. (SSC CHSL Tier-01 19/04/21)
questions.s: The relative pronoun 'that' is incorrect. 'What' should be used to mean 'the thing that'.

questions.q: This is they who deserve recognition for their tireless efforts in preserving the environment.
o: its they who deserve
It is they who deserve
It is they who deserves
questions.s:
The correct option to improve the sentence is: (b) It is they who deserve.

It is used in a sentence as a subject to emphasize the Noun or the Pronoun.

Therefore, the corrected sentence is: "It is they who deserve recognition for their tireless efforts in preserving the environment."

questions.q:
My shoes were worn out so I had to buy a new one.

(CGL Tier-1-03/03/2020 S3)
questions.s:
Correct Answer: new ones

"shoes" is plural, so the replacement for them should also be plural. The correct phrase is "new ones", where "ones" replaces the plural noun "shoes".

Correct Sentence: My shoes were worn out, so I had to buy new ones.

questions.q: I will encourage (a) / every one of my students (b) / to pursue the path of honesty (c) / in their life. (d)
o: every one of my students
to pursue the path of honesty
questions.s:
Every one is singular, so the pronoun should also be singular — his or her, not their.
Correct sentence: I will encourage every one of my students to pursue the path of honesty in his or her life.

questions.q: He is (1)/ fatter (2)/ than me. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.s: When using the comparative form "fatter," the pronoun following "than" should be in its subject form, "I," not the object form "me."

questions.q:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
You should / avail this opportunity / to demonstrate / your skills.
questions.s:
The erroneous part is "avail this opportunity"

Key Points

  • In the given sentence, we need to use "yourself of" after "avail"
  • In the given sentence, "avail" is a di-transitive verb that can have two objects (Direct object and Indirect object). Whenever we don't know what object we have to use then we use a reflexive pronoun according to the main subject.
  • Hence, we need to use "yourself of"
  • Let's see an example-
    • Residents visiting the library could avail themselves of the park district’s facilities and programs.

So the correct sentence is- You should avail yourself of this opportunity to demonstrate your skills.

questions.q: Q33. Q[35]. The workers ______ the manager fired are protesting. [Bank PO 2021]
questions.s: 'Whom' as object for people. व्यक्तियों के लिए object के रूप में 'whom' का प्रयोग।

questions.q: Do you know (1)/ whom the (2)/ next speaker is? (3)/ No Error (4)
questions.s:
After a preposition like “whom”, the structure must be correct, but here “whom” is wrongly used because it acts as the subject complement after the verb ‘is’.
So we need “who”, not “whom.”
Correct sentence: “Do you know who the next speaker is?”

questions.q: Please bring your homework, and I'll bring my.
o: and I'll bring my
questions.s:
The sentence has an error. The correct form should be: and I'll bring mine. A possessive pronoun can be used as the object of a verb.

So, the corrected sentence is: “Please bring your homework, and I'll bring mine.”

questions.q: Q33. Q33. Don’t worry I will (a)/ provide anything what you (b)/ need for your higher studies. (c) No error (d)
questions.s: After indefinite pronouns like "anything", the relative pronoun "that" should be used instead of "what".

questions.q: Did ( there ) bus come on time ?
questions.s:
The correct sentence is: “Did their bus come on time?”
Here, “their” is the correct possessive adjective for “bus.”
